headline: EC Restores 88 Missing Voters in Goa
summary: The Election Commission announced that 88 out of 97 omitted voters in Goa have been reinstated. Three of the remaining individuals were identified as Portuguese citizens.

headline: High Court Demands Answers Over Deleted Voters
summary: The Bombay High Court has questioned the Election Commission regarding the removal of six names from Goa's electoral rolls. The court raised concerns about potential technical glitches.

headline: HC Questions Automated Rejections of Form 8
summary: The Bombay High Court has asked the Election Commission of India to explain the automated rejection of Form 8 applications. The court emphasized that software-based decisions should not bypass manual checks.

headline: Goa-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Extended to Bengaluru
summary: The Vande Bharat Express running between Goa and Mangaluru will now extend its service to Bengaluru. This extension is set to improve travel options for passengers across the region.

headline: Vande Bharat Extension to Boost Karnataka-Goa Rail Link
summary: The Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express will be extended to Bengaluru to strengthen rail connectivity. The move is expected to benefit commuters traveling between Karnataka and Goa.

headline: Goa-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Timings and Stops Announced
summary: The newly extended Goa-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express will now run up to Yesvantpur in Bengaluru. Passengers can now check the revised schedule and stops for the train.

headline: Teenage Girl Abducted Near Calangute School
summary: A 14-year-old girl was reportedly abducted near a school in the Calangute area. Local authorities are investigating the incident.

headline: CBI Probes Multi-Crore Fixed Deposit Fraud
summary: The CBI has booked four Canara Bank officials and two others in connection with a multi-crore fixed deposit scam. The agency is conducting further investigations into the financial fraud.

headline: Nightclub Owners Offer Compensation to Fire Victims' Kin
summary: The owners of a Goa nightclub have offered ₹15 lakh ex gratia to the families of victims who died in a fire incident. The Bombay High Court has asked for a reply regarding the offer.

headline: Fuel Tanker Plunges Into Waterbody at Adpai
summary: A diesel tanker slipped off a private ferry and fell into a waterbody at Adpai. Emergency teams are working to handle the situation.

headline: Rosetta Hospitality Plans ₹650 Crore Expansion
summary: Rosetta Hospitality has earmarked ₹650 crore for its upcoming expansion plans. The funds will be utilized for developments in Sakleshpur, Goa, and Kalipura.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Relocates to Goa
summary: A couple with monthly expenses of ₹1.3 lakh decided to move from Bengaluru to Goa. They shared their motivations for choosing a lifestyle change in the coastal state.

headline: CJP Plans Protest Demanding Resignation of EC Chief
summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace has announced protests in Goa, Bengaluru, and Kolkata. The demonstrations will demand the resignation of Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

headline: Mock Drills Test Goa's Disaster Preparedness
summary: Authorities in Goa conducted simulated emergency exercises to test the efficiency of the state's disaster response systems. The drills evaluated local coordination and response times.

headline: South Goa Records Majority of September Dengue Cases
summary: South Goa accounted for 63 of the 66 dengue cases reported across the state in September. Health authorities are monitoring the situation.

headline: 88 Left-Out Goa Voters File Form 6
summary: Goa’s Chief Electoral Officer confirmed that 88 out of 97 voters who were left out have successfully filed Form 6. Their applications have been accepted for voter reinstatement.

headline: Cabinet Approves SPV for Namo Tarang Water Metro
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved the formation of a Special Purpose Vehicle to implement the Namo Tarang project. This step advances the state's plans for a water metro system.

headline: Draft Roll Cannot Be Used to Delete Voters, Rules HC
summary: The Goa bench of the Bombay High Court ruled that voters' names cannot be deleted based solely on a draft electoral roll. The court emphasized the need for proper hearings before any such removals.

headline: TVS MotoSoul 6.0 Set for December in Goa
summary: The sixth edition of the TVS MotoSoul biking festival will take place in Goa on December 11 and 12. The event promises to gather motorcycle enthusiasts from across the country.

headline: Portuguese Decree Sparks Historical Debate in Goa
summary: The 500th anniversary of a 16th-century Portuguese decree has triggered fresh historical debates in Goa. Researchers and locals are reflecting on its long-term cultural impact.

headline: Art Host Rob From MAD Reflects on Career Success
summary: Harun Robert, popularly known as Rob from the hit show MAD, shares insights into his current creative projects. He revealed that he is now earning more than ever through his diverse ventures.

headline: 88 Voters Reinstated in Goa's SIR Row
summary: The Election Commission has updated the cases of 97 missing voters in Goa, restoring or accepting 88 names. The update follows public concerns over omissions during the Special Summary Revision.

headline: Goa Reinstates 88 Voters; Three Excluded Over Passports
summary: Goa has restored 88 omitted voters to the electoral rolls, while three others were excluded for holding Portuguese passports. The action addresses the recent voter deletion controversy.

headline: CEO Confirms Acceptance of 88 Form 6 Applications
summary: Goa's Chief Electoral Officer stated that 88 out of 97 omitted voters have successfully filed Form 6. Their applications have been accepted to re-include them in the electoral rolls.

headline: 88 Omitted Voters Re-enrolled in Goa SIR Controversy
summary: Amid the ongoing Special Summary Revision controversy, 88 out of 97 left-out voters in Goa have submitted Form 6. Their applications have been formally accepted by electoral authorities.

headline: HC Rules Against Deleting Voters Without a Hearing
summary: The Bombay High Court ruled that the draft electoral roll cannot be used to delete voters' names without giving them a hearing. The court highlighted the importance of due process in electoral updates.

headline: CEO Releases Report on 97 Omitted Voters
summary: Goa's Chief Electoral Officer has released a status report regarding 97 left-out voters. The report confirms that 88 Form 6 applications have been accepted.

headline: Actor Aadesh Chaudhary Shares His Love for Goa
summary: Television actor Aadesh Chaudhary revealed that he has visited Goa more than 20 times. He described the state as one of his favorite destinations for relaxation.

headline: Margao Bus Stand Project Delayed by Red Tape
summary: The tender process for the Margao bus stand development has been delayed due to government red tape. Commuters continue to face inconvenience due to the pending upgrades.

headline: SDPOs Swapped in Panaji and Porvorim Transfer Twist
summary: In a sudden administrative shift, the Sub-Divisional Police Officers of Panaji and Porvorim have swapped their charges. The transfers have generated interest within the local police force.

headline: Senior Citizen Panels Defunct Since March
summary: As Goa celebrates Elders' Day, key panels dedicated to senior citizens have remained defunct since March. Activists have raised concerns over the lack of functional support systems.

headline: EC Publishes Status of 97 Left-Out Goa Voters
summary: The Election Commission has released the status of 97 left-out voters in Goa. The data shows 88 applications were accepted, while three individuals held Portuguese passports.

headline: Goa's GST Revenue Falls Short of Annual Target
summary: Goa's Goods and Services Tax collections have fallen 10% below the state's annual target. Authorities are evaluating strategies to address the revenue deficit.

headline: Porvorim Flyover Project Criticized Over Road Design
summary: The ₹641-crore Porvorim flyover project in Goa has drawn criticism as an example of poor road planning. Experts are highlighting the challenges in its execution and layout.

headline: Goa Records Driest Monsoon Season in 50 Years
summary: Goa has experienced its driest monsoon season in five decades, raising concerns over water availability. The deficit has impacted various sectors across the state.

headline: IMD Reports 31.7% Monsoon Deficit in Goa
summary: The India Meteorological Department reported a 31.7% rainfall deficit during the 2026 monsoon season in Goa. The low rainfall marks a significant dry spell for the state.

headline: Govt Approves Land for Affordable Housing in Parcem
summary: The Goa government has cleared land for its first affordable housing project, which will be located in Parcem. The initiative aims to provide budget-friendly housing options for locals.

headline: Government Appoints New Administrative Tribunal President
summary: The Goa government has officially appointed a new president to head the state's administrative tribunal. The appointment aims to streamline resolving administrative disputes.

headline: House Destroyed in Arpora Fire; Family Safe
summary: A major fire broke out and destroyed a residential house in Arpora. Fortunately, the family members managed to escape the flames unhurt.

headline: Coast Guard Rescues Sick Sailor Off Goa Coast
summary: The Indian Coast Guard successfully evacuated an ailing sailor from a merchant vessel off the coast of Goa. The patient was transported safely for urgent medical care.

headline: Union Agriculture Minister to Launch 'Goa Fresh'
summary: The Union Agriculture Minister is scheduled to launch the 'Goa Fresh' initiative to support local farming. The project aims to improve the distribution of fresh local produce.

headline: Goa's Charter Tourism Season Starts Early
summary: Goa's charter tourism season commenced early this year with the arrival of the first flight from Russia carrying 126 tourists. Industry operators are optimistic about the upcoming season.

headline: Erratic Monsoon Raises Concerns for Goa's Farmers
summary: An unpredictable monsoon season has created challenges for agricultural communities across Goa. Farmers are worrying about the impact of the uneven rainfall on their crops.

headline: Special Voter Enrolment Drive Launched in Goa
summary: A special voter registration drive has been initiated in Goa to target first-time and left-out voters. The campaign aims to ensure maximum participation in upcoming elections.

headline: WRD Taps Kushavati River to Save Selaulim Water
summary: Goa's Water Resources Department is tapping the Kushavati River to conserve water reserves at the Selaulim dam. The initiative is designed to address potential water shortages.

headline: Speaker Assures ST Seat Reservations Before 2027
summary: Speaker Ramesh Tawadkar has assured that assembly seat reservations for Scheduled Tribes will be implemented before the 2027 polls. The announcement was welcomed by community leaders.

headline: Union Minister Praises 'Swayampurna Goa' Initiative
summary: The Union Agriculture Minister praised the 'Swayampurna Goa' program as a successful model for national development. He also took the opportunity to criticize the Congress party's political campaign.

headline: Goa Psychiatric Institute Faces Patient Discharge Issue
summary: A leading psychiatric institute in Goa is facing challenges as cured patients often have nowhere to go. Many families are hesitant to take them back, leading to prolonged stays.

headline: HC Criticizes EC Over Software-Based Voter Deletions
summary: The Bombay High Court slammed the Election Commission for relying on software that led to the deletion of six family members' names in Santa Cruz. The court stressed that automated tools must not replace human diligence.

headline: Congress Attacks Ruling Government at Tivim Event
summary: The Congress party targeted the ruling establishment during a political gathering in Tivim. Leaders criticized the current administration's policies and performance.
